mapper.sql: r.RevisionNo, r.Title, r.WordCount, r.EditedBy AS EditedById, a.PenName AS EditedByPenName, r.CreatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dbo.ChapterRevision r JOIN dbo.Author a ON a.UserId = r.EditedBy WHERE r.ChapterId = #{chapterId} ORDER BY r.RevisionNo DESC
SELECT , r.Content FROM dbo.ChapterRevision r JOIN dbo.Author a ON a.UserId = r.EditedBy WHERE r.ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND r.RevisionNo = #{revisionNo}
